title: Digital Innovation Strategies for Community Banks
summary: Explore how your community bank can leverage embedded finance, offer real-time capabilities and ensure compliance to compete in a digital-first market.
body_markdown:
Community banks are under pressure to modernize as customer demand for digital experiences grows. To compete, they need infrastructure that supports embedded finance, real-time capabilities and evolving compliance needs.


Insights from Treasury Prime’s[2025 Banking Innovation Index](https://www.treasuryprime.com/blog/2025-banking-innovation-index-community-banks-embrace-embedded-finance) show leaders are confident in their modernization efforts, but challenges remain as banks work to bring new digital offerings to scale.


Curious how your bank can innovate for growth?[Download the tip sheet to learn more](https://go.treasuryprime.com/rs/253-WQB-828/images/3-Ways-Technology-Is-Fueling-Market-Expansion-Tip-Sheet.pdf?version=0) **.**
